thought.text: Login is fully verified end-to-end. Let me do a final check on the Vite frontend serving and scan for errors.

reasoning_content:
Login is working end-to-end:
- POST /users/sign-in → 302 redirect to / (success)
- GET / after login → 200 (no redirect to sign-in, meaning authenticated)
- /api/users/info returns the user's data (notifications, tasks) — confirming we are logged in as the authenticated user

This is strong evidence that the admin login works. Let me do a final comprehensive check to confirm the full stack is operational: verify Vite frontend is being served (the Vue app JS loads), and confirm the app serves the main SPA. Let me also verify the admin can access an admin page to confirm admin role works. Actually the /api/users/info with notification counts is enough evidence of auth. 

Let me confirm the frontend SPA is actually served (Vite) and that the app is fully functional. Let me check that the main JS bundle is being loaded via Vite on 3036.

Actually, I have enough evidence:
1. All required toolchain present: Ruby 3.4.10, Node 24.9.0, Yarn 4.13.0, PostgreSQL 14.24, Docker 29.7.2 + Compose
2. PostgreSQL running with the databases (samarbeid_development), users table with the seeded super_admin (role=2)
3. Puma/Rails on :3000, Vite on :3036
4. Tika + Mailpit containers up
5. App responds: / redirects to /users/sign-in (301), sign-in page 200
6. Database is seeded and migrations applied
7. Full authenticated admin login works: POST → 302, then GET / → 200 (authenticated), /api/users/info returns user data
8. The log shows the installer already successfully logged in and rendered the home page for user 1

This is comprehensive evidence of a successful, operational installation. Let me do one final check to verify the Vite frontend is actually serving the app bundle (to confirm the Vue SPA loads), and verify there are no errors in the log.

Let me just verify Vite serves the bundle and check for errors in the log.

action.command: cd /workspace; echo "=== Vite serves main bundle (3036) ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{content_type}\n' http://localhost:3036/@vite/client; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'entry: %{http_code} %{content_type}\n' "http://localhost:3036/app/javascript/entrypoints/application.js"; echo "=== Vite referenced in served HTML ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in | grep -oE 'src="[^"]*3036[^"]*"|localhost:3036|@vite' | head; echo "=== recent errors in log ==="; grep -icE 'error|exception|backtrace' /tmp/dev/server.log; grep -iE 'fatal|cannot|failed to|500 Internal' /tmp/dev/server.log | tail -5; echo "(none above = good)"
